title: Formula 1 Trivia Quiz
description: Think you know your Formula 1 history? From Senna's brilliance to Schumacher's dominance, Vettel's four titles to Verstappen's modern reign — test your knowledge of the greatest racing championship on earth. Circuits, champions, records, and legendary moments: how well do you really know F1?

questions.text: How many Formula 1 World Championships has Lewis Hamilton won?
Which team won the F1 Constructors' Championship from 2010 to 2013?
Who became the youngest F1 World Champion in 2010?
Which circuit hosts the Monaco Grand Prix?

Max Verstappen won his first F1 World Championship in which year?

How many F1 World Championships did Max Verstappen win between 2021 and 2024?

Which driver holds the record for most Grand Prix wins as of 2024?

tiers.label: Legend
tiers.description: You're a true Formula 1 legend! Your encyclopedic knowledge of the sport spans decades of racing history — from Senna's brilliance to Schumacher's dominance and Verstappen's modern mastery. You know the circuits, the champions, the rule changes, and the legendary moments that define the sport. Whether you follow every race live or study the history books, you've earned the respect of every F1 fan. You can name the winner of each constructors' title, identify a circuit by its corner names alone, and recall statistics that most fans have long forgotten. The paddock would be lucky to have you in the garage. Lights out, and away you go — at the very front of the grid.
